input: Hi, I have been a customer for three years and this is the first time I have had to write in. My bank says there are no blocks on the card and nothing shows as declined on their side. I also noticed that the billing page takes a very long time to load and sometimes shows an older address that I changed last month. I need this resolved today because my service is scheduled to be suspended tomorrow morning if the invoice remains unpaid. Please let me know what information you need from me.
